source: records/target/animation/BOHEMIA_WHAT_A_MAN_HOLDS.json (the clips), laid on COMBAT's posed men by tools/bohemia_animation_what_a_man_holds.py, rendered by DIRECTION's master rig the way COMBAT renders the fight

hold.PIdle: pistol low in the right hand at the thigh, the muzzle forward and down; check: up before the eyes, the left hand on the slide; key 6 the pistol half way up, on its way to the eyes and back
hold.PCarryWalk: pistol low in the right hand, the left arm swinging with the walk
hold.PAim: the right arm straight out at the eye, one hand, the body bladed; the kick lifts the wrist
hold.PHit: rocked back, the pistol kept in the right hand
hold.CoverLong: on one knee, the long gun across him at the low ready; a breath; a peek up
hold.CoverLongAim: up on the knee, the long gun at the shoulder over the cover, the kick, the settle
hold.CoverPistol: on one knee, the pistol up at the chest, the muzzle up, the left hand on the knee
hold.CoverPistolAim: up on the knee, one arm out over the cover
hold.CoverBare: on one knee and ducked low, the hands tucked in
hold.CoverHit: on the knee, rocked back, the gun kept in the right hand

cell: [x, y, w, h, dx, dy]: the cell on the sheet and where its top left sits from the look's fight-sheet cell origin (so his feet are where they were: the fight sheet's foot)
